# iyal.ink — Screenwriting Software Engineering

> iyal.ink builds minimalist, distraction-free screenwriting software powered by the open Fountain plain-text format.

## Products

- [ActOne Screenplay Editor](https://iyal.ink/actone/): Desktop Fountain screenplay editor featuring live syntax formatting, outline tree navigator, focus mode, X-Ray screenplay analytics, production breakdown tagging, Rust PDF export engine, and the Muse AI screenplay assistant. Available for Windows and Linux.
- [Fount TUI Screenplay Editor](https://iyal.ink/fount/): Open-source Rust terminal (TUI) screenplay editor built for writers who prefer terminal speed, keyboard navigation, Catppuccin Mocha themes, automated session snapshots, and distraction-free writing. Available for Linux, Windows, and macOS via Cargo.

## Core Concepts & Standards

- [Fountain Standard Syntax](https://fountain.io): Universal plain-text markup language for screenplays. Files saved in `.fountain` format remain future-proof, portable, and human-readable without proprietary locks.
- [ActOne Downloads Hub](https://iyal.ink/actone/downloads/): Download ActOne for Windows (Microsoft Store) or join our Discord community for early Linux builds.
- [Fount Downloads Hub](https://iyal.ink/fount/downloads/): Download Fount terminal editor binaries or install via `cargo install fount`.
- [Blog & Screenwriting Journal](https://iyal.ink/blog/): Screenwriting workflow essays, Fountain format guides, release notes, and technical updates from iyal.ink.
